patterns: Narasimham Committee is asked as a one-liner: what it relates to (banking reforms), its 1991 official name (Committee on the Financial System), what it cut (SLR/CRR).
APPSC tests merger facts directly: Dena + Vijaya into Bank of Baroda (1 Apr 2019), Andhra Bank into Union Bank of India.
Basel items are definitional (Basel II = capital adequacy standards, Basel III = shock resilience) plus a NOT-correct trap on Tier 1 % in India.
APPSC G1 asks multi-statement items on EASE reforms and CRAR meaning; committee-to-subject matching recurs across PSCs.
App MCQs push deeper into exact buffer percentages, RRB Viability Plan and 2025-26 law amendments than PYQs require.
